info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Campaign Design Creation API
info.description: The Campaign Design Creation API enables businesses to create tailored designs for marketing prospect campaigns. This endpoint allows users to define and submit various visual elements that will be used in promotional outreach efforts. Typical consumers include marketing teams and campaign managers who need to quickly generate and test new design concepts. Integrated seamlessly into marketing workflows, this API enhances the efficiency of campaign setups by automating the design process and ensuring consistency across various channels.

post.summary: Create a new prospect campaign design.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new design for a prospect campaign in the marketing system. You can submit the relevant design details, which will be processed to establish a new campaign design.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update designs for marketing prospect campaigns. The payload should contain the necessary details for the design elements and configurations required in the campaign.

201.description: The design has been created successfully and is now available.
